items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: Professor Bennett there, my mother was going to get him to teach me. But he had so many, sometimes he might come that day and couldn't come the next day... So I just told him to forget about it.

ctx.x: Florida get high, she wouldn't show up.

I said, I said, I told my mother, I said, you paying all that money to Florida to teach me music? I said, Florida ain't going to show up. I was young too, you know, I told her. I said, forget about it, Mom. I said, I got a good ear from music. I learned how to play. That's why when I said, well, I went over and that Florida didn't come, so Professor Bennett there, my mother was going to get him to teach me. But he had so many, sometimes he might come that day and couldn't come the next day, you know what I mean?…
Did Florida play, was she just a teacher or did she play herself?
